taste:
The Mixed Grill is a hearty, meat-led plate with smoky grilled flavours and a range of textures. Thick gammon steak sits alongside tender pork loin, flavourful rump steak, a succulent lamb chop and savoury sausage. The appeal is variety: you can move between different cuts rather than work through a single steak, with each meat contributing to the substantial pub-food character.

A freshly fried egg crowns the meat, while a large portion of chips completes the plate. This is a traditional, unpretentious meal built for a considerable appetite. Choose it when the assortment of meats matters more to you than focusing on one particular cut.
